NTPC Assistant Executive Online Form 2025 – Full Details

National Thermal Power Corporation Limited (NTPC) has released the Notification for the recruitment of 400 Assistant Executive Posts through the Its Official Website of NTPC. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official All India Exam Result website which is All India Exam ResultFor all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for this recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 12 February 2025
  • Application Start Date : 15 February 2025
  • Last Date : 01 March 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : Rs. 00/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Official Website
